Tess (PM): tiny sync  we need to pick a single direction for the Dedicated milestone: focus on predictable billing & strict caps OR flexible burst with dynamic lane borrowing. can't do both this cycle.
Kyo (Eng): note on cost/operational surface: dynamic lane borrowing (allowing pools to borrow from nearby tiers) adds complexity to admission and increases eviction churn. but it improves utilization.
Rafael (SRE): from oncall: churn risk is real. propose a middle path: implement an SLO-backed spill policy where spillover is allowed only if tenant has explicit SLO waiver for latency (opt-in per-event). that reduces surprise.
Marta (Product Ops): customers care about chargeback clarity. if we do borrowing we must expose per-call attribution and a clear audit trail. billing-bot: queued export schema change request.
Jun (Sales): most customers prefer predictability for invoicing. they'd pay for a temporary "event lane" rather than ambiguous borrowing. sales preference = strict caps + purchasable event lanes.
Kyo (Eng): technical proposal for MVP: 1) strict reserved_quota + purchasable event_lane (timebox, token-limited), 2) spill_policy = off by default, event_lane can enable same-tier spillonly, 3) admission respects ledger atomicity. sample config:
```
tenant_capacity: {reserved: 2e6, event_lane: {tokens:5e5, window_min:120, enabled:false}}
spill_policy: "off"
```
Rafael (SRE): operational need: "eviction baton" flow if we do borrowing later. mechanism: preempt handshake that signals a running session to checkpoint and optionally retry on lower tier. add console revoke and event audit.
Marta (Product Ops): launch criteria: API + console for event lanes, billing export columns [reserved_used, event_lane_used, event_window_id], revoke button, and e2e flood/replay tests. default = strict caps (no automatic borrowing).
Jun (Sales): sales to draft event-lane pricing and contract language: "Event Lanes are timeboxed and billed per token; overflow beyond purchased tokens will be throttled unless pay-as-you-go is enabled."
billing-bot: created ticket BILL-2024: add event_lane fields to usage export and invoice mapping.
Tess (PM): decision = ship strict-reserved + event-lane add-on for this milestone. revisit dynamic borrowing + eviction baton in Qn+1 after pilot. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
